briefing.headline: Nvidia reported strong quarterly results on Tuesday, but the stock and AI shares have been swinging after CEO Jensen Huang's exit.

points.text: Nvidia's Q3 fiscal 2027 revenue was $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year ago. Data center revenue was $107.6 billion, up 110%.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia's board says it unanimously accepted Jensen Huang's resignation and does not intend to reinstate him as CEO.
points.label: reported

points.text: Colette Kress is interim CEO. Harvey Jones is the company's first board chair. Huang is cooperating with a board investigation into his ties to an alleged Chinese intelligence figure.
points.label: reported

points.text: AMD, Broadcom and TSMC shares rose after Nvidia's earnings beat. Nvidia, the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq had fallen in the days before.
points.label: reported

points.text: The US moved to restrict foreign countries from giving Chinese firms remote access to advanced AI chips.
points.label: reported
